node.title: Re^5: loop iterator in a string
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I think rejecting any $str containing anything which isn't a cipher, comma or dot prior to eval $str should be good enough

Not quite, since it would also accept ",....," and other things like that (one of the things I meant with "other subtle bugs"). Personally I would suggest both a regex like /\A(\d+(?:\.\.\d+)?)(?:,(?1))*\z/ and checking [doc://eval] for errors. And at that level, the complexity is high enough that something like* [tybalt89]'s [id://11137071|solution] is probably better.

* Update: By which I mean, something like [tybalt89]'s solution with some added error checking ;-)
